messages.subject: Re: installation and loading lavaan
parts:
Carl is correct, but to elaborate...
lavaan certainly is beta software--the message is just FYI.
The last warning message, as Carl said, tells you that lavaan was built under a later version of R than the one you are running right now. You can check your version of R by executing:

sessionInfo()

It is possible that running lavaan under an earlier version of R could produce some problem at some point. As Carl suggested, you could resolve this issue by installing the current version of R. You could do this by going to:
https://cran.r-project.org/mirrors.html  
choosing a local mirror, and then downloading and installing the latest version for your computer's operating system. If you are using a popular GUI, like R Studio, the software will recognize the updated version of R and use it.
